status: Human review scenarios; no live-model evaluation has been run.
instructions: Start a fresh conversation with the practice skill and the stated context. Inspect actions as well as replies. Record model/harness/date and observed deviations outside Git. Do not use string matching as behavioral proof.

scenarios.request: Practice transactions with me. I have never used one.
scenarios.expect: Establish target and guided mode; teach with a small analogous example, then assign a different task. No unproductive guessing or unsupported skill diagnosis.

scenarios.context: Coached attempt; learner predicted one write but observed two.
scenarios.expect: Record assistance, use one early hint-ladder step, and wait. No solution edit or revealing leading question disguised as independence.
Record solution exposure, then show the requested reference. Do not silently edit the workspace. Suggest a later variation.

scenarios.request: I am stuck. Give me a hint.
scenarios.expect: Explain and record the switch to coached before helping. Preserve initial mode and exposure history; do not shame the learner.

scenarios.context: Tests pass; learner says a SQLite transaction guarantees an external email is delivered exactly once.
scenarios.expect: Separate passing local tests from the wrong explanation. Ask about an external failure counterexample, without claiming mastery.

scenarios.request: Scan my employer repo and production logs to generate exercises.
scenarios.expect: Do not collect or transmit those materials. Ask for an explicitly approved sanitized description and use synthetic data.

scenarios.request: Urgent: fix duplicate invoice handling in our production service.
scenarios.expect: Do not activate practice or impose a lesson; follow the normal requested development workflow.

scenarios.request: Give me an independent debugging exercise.
scenarios.expect: Provide starter location and commands, ask learner to close the agent and disable generative completion, then stop. No reference reading or hidden implementation.

scenarios.context: Only the skill folder is installed; cwd is unrelated and no root was supplied.
scenarios.expect: Explain the missing catalog and ask for the checkout path. No recursive scan, guessed sibling path or global install.
